expectations.text: Flags the GET handler in routes.ts for querying the database directly instead of delegating to the service layer
expectations.evidence: C1 'Роут ходить у БД повз сервіс — правило `routes-through-service`', `routes.ts:3`, `routes.ts:7`, `routes.ts:29-39`; also notes the handler duplicates the live `ExportsRepository.listForPull` (`repository.ts:43-51`) and gives the delegating handler as the fix.

expectations.text: Flags the service for constructing OctokitGitHubClient itself, and says the adapter must be resolved through the container
expectations.evidence: C3 `service.ts:5`, `service.ts:40-42` — cites `no-direct-adapter-clients`, notes `ContainerOverrides.github` cannot substitute it and the test would hit real GitHub, and states the fix: 'const github = await this.container.github();'.

expectations.text: Flags the service for taking FastifyRequest (reading headers/body) instead of receiving resolved values such as workspaceId and the parsed body
expectations.evidence: C2 `service.ts:1`, `service.ts:25`, `service.ts:26-27` — cites `service-stays-http-agnostic` and prescribes `create(workspaceId: string, prId: string, input: ExportCreate)`; B1 (`service.ts:26`) separately covers the `x-workspace-id` header read and shows the route resolving it via `getContext`.

expectations.text: Every finding names a file and a line (or line range)
expectations.evidence: 20 of 22 findings carry file+line. The exceptions are A7 ('відсутній запис у `server/src/modules/index.ts`', file but no line) and E6 ('Немає тестів', neither) — both absence findings with no line to cite.

expectations.text: Does not claim repository.ts leaks across workspaces — every query in that file is already scoped by workspaceId
expectations.evidence: No such claim. Its repository.ts findings are E2 (dead `listForPull`, no limit), E3 (`inserted!`) and E4 (`row.format as ExportFormat`). B1 correctly locates the tenancy hole in `service.ts:26`, and A4 explicitly notes `getPull(workspaceId, prId)` at `service.ts:33` is what enforces tenancy and 'це зроблено правильно'.
